text: The owner signs in with Google, then lands in a protected workspace. Client links stay separate and token based, so clients never need a freelancer account.

text: Now we paste the client material once. The agent extracts deliverables, acceptance criteria, dates, exclusions, and revision policy into a structured record.

text: The worker runs in the background, records each step, and only asks for facts the source cannot answer. That keeps the handoff small and auditable.

text: The freelancer creates a secure clarification link. The client reviews the plan, answers missing details, and confirms the exact hash of the agreement.

caption: After confirmation, v1 is locked. New asks go through Guardrail instead of silently changing the agreement.
text: After confirmation, version one is locked. A new ask now goes through Guardrail instead of silently changing what was already approved.

caption: Guardrail suggests CHANGE_REQUEST with citations. The freelancer still confirms the decision explicitly.
text: Guardrail proposes a change request with citations from the baseline. The model does not decide on its own; the freelancer confirms the classification explicitly.

caption: The change is staged as v2, then confirmed through the same client review path.
text: The change is staged as version two, then confirmed through the same client review path, without overwriting version one.

caption: Delivery evidence is attached directly to acceptance criteria, then sent back for client review.
text: When the work is delivered, evidence is attached directly to acceptance criteria, then sent back through a delivery review link.

caption: The client accepts or requests changes criterion by criterion. The review becomes part of the audit trail.
text: The client accepts or requests changes criterion by criterion. The review session becomes part of the audit trail.

caption: The final proof packet exports baseline hash, evidence, client decisions, and audit events as JSON or Markdown.
text: The final proof packet exports the baseline hash, evidence, client decisions, and audit events as JSON or Markdown. That is the operational utility: fewer disputes, less follow-up, and a clean record of what really happened.
